12Pi/12-1-1.jpg.pxPerMmNote: 12Pi -1 shot: px/mm estimated as (front-tooth corner x - left silhouette corner x) / R (R = 6 mm): the left silhouette tooth is at -90 deg and the next tooth faces the camera; 4 shots agree 66.7-74.2 px/mm; uncertainty ~ +-15 %
12Pi/12-1-1.jpg.notes: 12Pi close-up: rough bright band along the front peripheral cutting edge = worn flank land with coating loss and smeared/adhered material (adhesion not separable at this focus -> class 2); the broken top of the band at the corner (within ~0.7 mm of the tip, jagged silhouette) = class 3; specular streaks on the flute (right) and the smooth end-face wedge = tool; defocused far part of the band = 255

12Pi/12-1-2.jpg.pxPerMmNote: 12Pi -2 shot: tool out of frame, SIFT registration to the -1 shot fails. px/mm = px/mm of the -1 shot of the same side (68.83) x 1.66, the pooled zoom ratio of the -1/-2 shots from the worn-land pixel width on sides 1-3 (1.65, 1.69, 1.65; side 4 land too small). The 10Pi -1/-2 pairs share one zoom, the 12Pi pairs do not. Uncertainty ~ +-25 %; VB of the -2 shot is NOT independent of the -1 shot (scale borrowed from the land width).
